project_meta.title: What If All Humans Became Vegetarian?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman storytelling with emotional cinematic visuals. Warm off-white paper texture, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, limited earthy colors, soft green fields, muted blue skies and warm orange sunlight. All human and animal characters use a consistent simple cartoon design. Stickman humans have round white faces, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes of identical size and spacing, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights, reflections or eyelashes, simple curved mouths, thin black stick limbs. The recurring presenter also wears a small red bow tie. Animals have simple expressive cartoon faces with tiny black dot eyes. For any animal shown as dead, use only two simple black X marks over its eyes as a non-graphic cartoon symbol. Never show blood, wounds, slaughter, knives, graphic suffering or disturbing imagery. Vertical 9:16 composition, one clear visual action per image, emotionally engaging but gentle storytelling.
global_style.negative_prompt: No blood, gore, wounds, slaughter scenes, knives, butcher scenes, graphic animal cruelty, realistic dead bodies, disturbing imagery, realistic anatomy, photorealism, 3D rendering, detailed human faces, changing stickman eye designs, pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights, reflections, eyelashes, extra eyes, watermarks, logos, readable text.

presenter.label: Recurring stickman presenter
presenter.visual_dna: A minimalist stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes identical in size and spacing in every appearance, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. No pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or realistic eye details.

cow.label: Gentle cow
cow.visual_dna: A friendly cartoon black-and-white cow with a rounded body, four simple legs, small horns, a pink muzzle and two tiny black dot eyes. Consistent proportions and gentle expression.

chicken.label: Small hen
chicken.visual_dna: A small cartoon brown hen with a rounded body, tiny wings, a red comb, orange beak and two tiny black dot eyes. Simple friendly hand-drawn design.

pig.label: Pink pig
pig.visual_dna: A cute rounded pink cartoon pig with short legs, a curly tail, a round snout and two tiny black dot eyes. Gentle expressive design.

goat.label: Young goat
goat.visual_dna: A small light-brown cartoon goat with short curved horns, four simple legs, floppy ears and two tiny black dot eyes.

farmer.label: Farmer
farmer.visual_dna: A simple stickman farmer with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights, thin black limbs, a straw hat and muted green clothes.

world.label: Modern human world
world.visual_dna: A modern world with cities, supermarkets, restaurants, farms, roads and homes. Minimalist hand-drawn illustration with warm off-white paper, bold black outlines and earthy colors.

farm.label: Open green farm
farm.visual_dna: A peaceful green farm with grassy fields, wooden fences, a red barn, trees, a small pond and a wide blue sky. Warm sunlight and hand-drawn black outlines.

market.label: Modern food market
market.visual_dna: A clean modern grocery market with shelves of vegetables, fruits, grains, pulses, dairy alternatives and packaged foods. Simple hand-drawn style with muted colors.

restaurant.label: Modern restaurant
restaurant.visual_dna: A cozy modern restaurant with wooden tables, simple chairs, a counter and a display of colorful plant-based meals. Warm lighting and minimalist ink outlines.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, अगर आज से पूरी दुनिया के इंसान शाकाहारी बन जाएँ?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic hand-drawn illustration of the recurring stickman presenter standing in the center of a modern city, surrounded by cows, chickens, pigs and goats walking peacefully among green parks. The presenter has a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, hopeful sunlight, earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish a modern world where humans and animals share space peacefully. Keep all character designs simple and consistent.

beats.narration_text: ना मांस के लिए जानवर मारे जाते, ना उनकी ज़िंदगी इंसानों की थाली के लिए होती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene showing a peaceful cow, hen, pig and goat standing freely in a green field while a human family watches them from a respectful distance. The animals have simple cartoon faces with tiny black dot eyes. The humans have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm paper texture, bold black outlines, soft green and yellow colors, no graphic imagery.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show animals as living individuals, not food products. Keep the scene gentle and hopeful.

beats.narration_text: सबसे बड़ा बदलाव हमारी प्लेट से शुरू होता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 top-down view of a dining table. A human hand gently places a colorful plate filled with rice, lentils, vegetables, salad and flatbread in the center. Around the plate are fresh fruits and grains. No meat products anywhere. Warm hand-drawn ink style, off-white paper background, earthy green and orange colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the vegetarian meal look delicious, varied and familiar rather than restrictive.

beats.narration_text: फार्मों पर गायें, मुर्गियाँ, सूअर और बकरियाँ अब आज़ादी से घूम पातीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 wide hand-drawn illustration of a peaceful green farm with cows grazing, hens walking through grass, pigs resting in the shade and goats exploring near a wooden fence. A red barn and trees sit in the background. All animals have simple cartoon faces with tiny black dot eyes. Warm golden sunlight, off-white paper texture, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Give each animal enough space and show natural relaxed behavior. No cages or distress.

beats.narration_text: मुर्गियाँ मिट्टी में दाना खोजतीं, और गायें खुले मैदान में चरतीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 ground-level close-up of a brown hen scratching soft earth and pecking at seeds while a black-and-white cow grazes peacefully behind her. Both animals have simple cartoon faces with tiny black dot eyes. Fresh green grass, tiny flowers, warm sunlight, hand-drawn black ink outlines on off-white paper.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on natural animal behaviors and a calm environment.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एक ही दिन में दुनिया बदलना इतना आसान भी नहीं होता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene of a farmer standing thoughtfully in front of a large farm, holding a notebook and looking at rows of animal shelters and green fields. The farmer has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, thin black stick limbs, straw hat and green clothes. Warm earthy colors, gentle thoughtful mood.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the practical challenge of changing an enormous food system. Keep the farmer's appearance consistent.

beats.narration_text: पहले से मौजूद लाखों जानवरों की देखभाल करनी पड़ती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 wide illustration of a large peaceful animal sanctuary with many cows, pigs, goats and chickens in separate spacious grassy areas. Several caretakers carry food and water buckets. All humans have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Animals have tiny dot eyes and relaxed expressions. Warm off-white paper, black outlines, soft green landscape.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show organized long-term care, food, water and shelter for existing animals.

beats.narration_text: और धीरे-धीरे मांस के लिए नए जानवर पालने की ज़रूरत कम हो जाती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn farm scene showing an old livestock barn being converted into a spacious animal shelter and green vegetable-growing area. The farmer stands nearby with a hopeful posture. A cow and goat walk freely outside. The farmer has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm sunlight, bold black ink outlines, earthy green palette.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Suggest a gradual transition from meat production toward animal care and other uses of farmland.

beats.narration_text: सुपरमार्केट की तस्वीर भी बदल जाती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 wide hand-drawn modern supermarket with colorful displays of vegetables, fruits, grains, beans, nuts and plant-based food products. A few stickman shoppers walk through the aisles carrying baskets. Every human has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, lively green and orange accents.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the market look modern, busy and abundant, not empty or unrealistic.

beats.narration_text: दालें, सब्ज़ियाँ, फल, अनाज और प्रोटीन के दूसरे विकल्प ज़्यादा अहम हो जाते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 close-up of a beautiful market display with lentils, chickpeas, kidney beans, tofu, nuts, leafy greens, tomatoes, bananas and whole grains arranged in separate wooden baskets. A shopper's hand reaches toward a basket of beans. Hand-drawn black ink outlines, warm paper texture, rich but restrained earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a wide variety of plant-based foods and protein sources clearly.

beats.narration_text: रेस्टोरेंट नए स्वाद और नई रेसिपी बनाते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cozy modern restaurant where a chef stickman prepares colorful vegetarian dishes: vegetable curry, lentil bowls, grilled vegetables and fresh salads. The chef has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, thin stick limbs and a simple chef hat. Warm orange kitchen light, hand-drawn black ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make vegetarian food look creative, appetizing and suitable for a modern restaurant.

beats.narration_text: और लोगों को अपनी सेहत के लिए सही पोषण का ध्यान भी रखना पड़ता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 top-down hand-drawn view of a balanced vegetarian meal with lentils, beans, vegetables, whole grains, fruit and a fortified food package. A simple notebook beside the plate shows tiny food icons arranged as a balanced meal diagram, without readable text. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, muted green and orange accents.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Communicate that a healthy vegetarian diet needs variety and planning, not just removing meat.

beats.narration_text: दुनिया भर के किसानों को भी नई फसलें उगाने और नए काम सीखने पड़ते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn illustration of farmers working in wide fields of beans, lentils, vegetables and grains. One farmer plants seedlings while another checks a crop row. Each farmer has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, simple stick limbs and earthy work clothes. Bright warm daylight, green fields, bold black ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show farmers adapting their work through new crops and agricultural skills.

beats.narration_text: कुछ जगह ज़मीन पर खाने की फसलें उग सकतीं, जहाँ पहले पशुओं के लिए चारा उगता था।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 aerial-style hand-drawn view of farmland divided into green crop plots. One side shows a grassy animal-feed field and the other shows rows of lentils, beans and vegetables. A small tractor moves along a path. Warm off-white paper texture, bold black ink outlines, muted green and brown colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a possible land-use change, not a claim that all grazing land can grow crops.

beats.narration_text: कुछ जानवरों को बचाने के लिए बड़े अभयारण्य और सुरक्षित जगहें बनानी पड़तीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 panoramic hand-drawn sanctuary with green hills, ponds, trees, open grassland and groups of cows, goats, pigs and chickens living in spacious protected areas. A few caretakers walk along a wooden path. Animals have tiny black dot eyes and peaceful expressions. Warm golden light, bold ink outlines, off-white paper texture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that animal welfare requires space, resources and careful management.

beats.narration_text: और इंसान सीखते कि जानवर सिर्फ खाने की चीज़ नहीं, बल्कि अपनी ज़िंदगी जीने वाले जीव हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 emotional close-up of a gentle black-and-white cow standing beside a young goat in a green field, looking calmly toward the viewer. In the soft background, a stickman child watches with curiosity and kindness. The child has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Animals have tiny dot eyes. Soft golden sunlight, warm paper texture, gentle hand-drawn outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create an empathetic moment that treats animals as living beings with their own needs and behaviors.

beats.narration_text: क्या इससे धरती को भी फायदा होता? कुछ मामलों में, हाँ।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn view of a green planet with forests, fields, rivers and a modern city. A small group of cows and goats graze peacefully in a field while birds fly overhead. The recurring presenter stands in the foreground pointing toward the planet. The presenter has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, round white face and red bow tie. Warm earthy colors, bold ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce environmental possibilities with a hopeful but balanced visual.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि कुछ तरह की पशुपालन गतिविधियों से ग्रीनहाउस गैसें निकलती हैं और बहुत ज़मीन भी इस्तेमाल होती है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 split hand-drawn composition. On the left, a livestock farm with cows in a field and a few simple pale gas-cloud symbols rising into the sky. On the right, a wide green field with trees and crops. No smoke disaster or dramatic pollution. Bold black outlines, warm off-white paper, muted earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use simple educational symbols to represent environmental impacts without implying every farm has identical effects.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन खेती भी पानी, ज़मीन और संसाधन इस्तेमाल करती है, इसलिए हर समस्या अपने आप खत्म नहीं होती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn illustration of a farmer watering vegetable crops with a small irrigation channel. Nearby are a water tank, soil rows, trees and a sun overhead. The farmer has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, round white face and straw hat. Warm paper texture, black ink outlines, muted green and brown palette.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that plant agriculture also needs responsible water and land management.

beats.narration_text: फिर भी, करोड़ों जानवरों को बेहतर ज़िंदगी मिलने का मतलब बहुत बड़ा बदलाव होता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hopeful wide scene of many cows, goats, pigs and chickens living in open green sanctuary fields, drinking from a pond, resting under trees and walking freely. The animals have consistent simple cartoon faces with tiny black dot eyes. A few caretakers watch from a distance. Warm golden sunlight, off-white paper texture, bold black outlines, soft earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the scene emotionally uplifting, with animals visibly safe and able to move naturally.

beats.narration_text: तो सोचो, अगर हमारी थाली बदलने से किसी जानवर को पूरी ज़िंदगी मिल सके, क्या तुम ये बदलाव अपनाओगे?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic final illustration of the recurring presenter sitting on a grassy hill, looking over a peaceful sanctuary where a cow, hen, pig and goat live freely. The presenter has a perfectly round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Warm sunset, gentle golden light, hand-drawn black ink outlines, off-white paper texture, emotional hopeful ending.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with a calm memorable image of humans choosing compassion and animals living peacefully. Preserve the presenter's exact eye design.
